# openobserve_stream (Resource)

Manages an OpenObserve stream's settings including data retention, partitioning, and indexing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openobserve_stream" "app_logs" {
  org_id      = "default"
  name        = "app-logs"
  stream_type = "logs"

  settings {
    data_retention        = 30
    full_text_search_keys = ["message", "body"]
    index_fields          = ["level", "service"]
    bloom_filter_fields   = ["trace_id"]

    partition_keys {
      field = "service"
      types = ["value"]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stream name.
- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier (e.g. `default`).
- `stream_type` (String) Stream type: `logs`, `metrics`, or `traces`.

### Optional

- `settings` (Attributes) Stream-level settings for data retention, indexing, and partitioning. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID in the format `{org_id}/{stream_type}/{name}`.

<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Optional:

- `bloom_filter_fields` (List of String) Fields with bloom filter acceleration.
- `data_retention` (Number) Number of days to retain data. Defaults to the cluster-wide retention setting.
- `full_text_search_keys` (List of String) Fields included in full-text search.
- `index_fields` (List of String) Fields that are indexed for fast filtering.
- `partition_keys` (Attributes List) Partition keys for data distribution and query pruning. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--partition_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--settings--partition_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.partition_keys`

Required:

- `field` (String) Log field used as the partition key.
- `types` (List of String) Partition key type(s). Typically `["value"]`.
